gloss: to reconstruct; to revive; to restore

definitions.gloss: to reconstruct; to revive; to restore
definitions.explanation: To rebuild or revitalize something that has been damaged, destroyed, or diminished, especially in the context of disaster recovery, economic revitalization, or cultural revival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{復興|ふっこう}した。
⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧。
examples.english: To support the reconstruction of the disaster-stricken area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく{復興|ふっこう}しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: After ten years since the earthquake, this area is finally in the process of rebuilding.

notes:
Refers to the large-scale rebuilding or revival of communities, economies, or cultures after destruction or decline. Commonly used in the context of natural disaster recovery in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: reconstruction support/aid
- ⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: reconstruction project
- ⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: reconstruction plan
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧: economic revival
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧: cultural renaissance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restore to the original state — focuses on returning infrastructure or systems to their prior condition, whereas ⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧ implies broader revitalization and development beyond mere repair
- ⟦{再建|さいけん}→再建：11743_saiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rebuild — focuses on physically rebuilding structures or organizations, while ⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧ encompasses the wider recovery of an entire community or economy
